OutOfTower:Stamina.NAME: Stamina
OutOfTower:Stamina.FLAVOR: Your basic vitality for surviving the world outside the Tower.
DESCRIPTIONS: Tracks your stamina. Starts at 100. If it drops below 0, you die instantly. The lower it gets, the more severe the negative effects become.

OutOfTower:Sanity.NAME: Sanity
OutOfTower:Sanity.FLAVOR: The horrors outside the Tower erode your mind.
DESCRIPTIONS: Tracks your sanity. Starts at 100. If it drops below 0, you die instantly. The lower it is, the harsher the negative effects you will suffer.

OutOfTower:WraithHeartcore.NAME: Wraith Heartcore
OutOfTower:WraithHeartcore.FLAVOR: Hatred intertwines tightly with demonic power.。
DESCRIPTIONS: 在战斗中，每当你造成或受到伤害时，获得 #b1 点本能。达到 #b3 点时失去 #b3 点，并获得 #b2 点力量，同时获得 #b1 回合易伤。
